items.title: Discovery path reuse benchmarked against exact rebuilds
items.detail: BENCHMARKED as a ONE-FACTOR comparison and NOT closed. The previous measurement varied reuse AND enumeration richness together and was unidentified; the amendment (decisions/2026-09-05-gate-4-7-amendment.md) narrows the gate to reuse alone. Substrate proved sound: filtering is exactly the identity at survival 1.000, zero hard failures. Approximation fails: exact leader preserved in 3/5 cases, 140/600 pairs inverted, worst objective rel gap 1.750e-02. The bias is systematic and directional -- zero at survival 1.000, growing as the candidate thins -- so reuse biases the search toward activating more lines. AND adjudication against D18 is blocked: D18 question 3 forbids discovery-effort comparison. A gate about a DISCOVERY-EFFORT approximation cannot close when discovery-effort comparison is itself forbidden. EXPERIMENT4_GATE47.md, outputs/exp4/gate47.json

items.title: Gap benchmark run on Experiment 4 networks, Q3 answered
items.detail: RUN on 36 cells over 4 network structures, by exhaustive enumeration of a reduced neighbourhood (K=3, N=[6, 8, 10]) under the production objective. Q1/Q2: median gap +0.297432%, max +0.645892%. Q3 ANSWER RECORDED: the gap TRACKS network structure; section 3 forbids discovery-effort comparison (largest structure-paired differential 0.381749 pp against a median absolute gap of 0.297432 pp, ratio 1.283 vs the limit 0.5 declared before any number existed). Q4: NO BAND EMITTED -- section 3's forbidding branch. discovery_effort_comparison_permitted=False. This item is MET and Experiment 4 is BLOCKED BY ITS ANSWER, which is a different thing. outputs/exp4/gap_benchmark.json
